newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends up 1.55 vs dlr at 1,073.15.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends up 1.55 vs dlr at 1,073.15.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 1.55 pesos higher against the dollar at 1,073.15 after rising on sales of U.S. currency by banks and exporters, interbank dealers said.
The sales included about $6 million from coffee and oil exporters, enough to put upward pressure on the peso in a relatively thin market.
Dealers reported 375 trades for a total of $173 million and said the peso traded in a 1,075.75-to-1,072.10 range.
